feedback.description: COUNT_DRIFT residue / ADR description stale (Step 11 cross-artifact reconciliation). The iteration-3 revision correctly reconciled the test-scenario count to 20 across the three places the prior finding F-08 named (test-scenarios.json counts.test_scenarios=20 line 17; implementation-plan.md §14 Counts line 321 = '20 (P0:2, P1:6, P2:6, P3:6)'; implementation-plan.md §8 Phase 1 TEST SCENARIOS line 215 now lists S2-P1-06; implementation-planner-output.json counts.test_scenarios=20, plan_complete event test_scenarios_count=20, and the test-scenarios artifact description all say 20). HOWEVER the fourth sub-item of the prior F-08 suggestion was NOT applied: implementation-planner-output.json line 30 (the tactical-adrs artifact description) still characterizes TADR-S2-01 as 'CertParseResult object-skills shape vs SKILL-1 string placeholder' — the SUPERSEDED iteration-1 decision. The actual tactical-adrs.md is the correct v2 (a z.preprocess normalizer accepting flat-object | top-level-array | already-canonical envelope and emitting a derived top-level confidence). The planner-output JSON metadata therefore contradicts the artifact it describes. Although the iteration-3 revision note on line 9 explicitly asserts 'No design, schema, scenario content, or ADR changes,' the F-08 remediation explicitly asked to 'align the stale description while reconciling counts' — so this is an unresolved carry-forward of a named prior finding, not a new gap. Impact is bounded (the test-creator and implementer consume tactical-adrs.md, which is correct; this is a prose mischaracterization in the planner's own output-bookkeeping field, not a contract/identifier/count mismatch), hence MEDIUM, but per the convergence gate (0 findings at all severities) it must be corrected before next_stage_ready.
feedback.suggestion: In implementation-planner-output.json line 30, replace the TADR-S2-01 description with its actual v2 decision, e.g.: "TADR-S2-01 v2 (CertParseResult reworked to a z.preprocess normalizer that accepts the flat single-skill object [AC-01], the top-level array [AC-02], and an already-canonical envelope, emitting a canonical {skills[], issuer?, confidence} with a derived top-level confidence = min(per-skill) for the array case so the callClaude gate fires for single- AND multi-skill)". No other artifact change is required — the counts and §8/§14 narrative are now consistent and were verified by enumeration.
